entities.name: Radovan Somík
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Radovan Somík is a Slovak former professional ice hockey player who played in the National Hockey League (NHL), Slovak Extraliga, Czech Extraliga, Swedish Hockey League, and Russian Super League. He played two NHL seasons for the Philadelphia Flyers from 2002 to 2004. He spent the final seven seasons of his career playing for Pardubice HC in the Czech Extraliga.
